column1: # adjudicated: 2026-09-22 clover-impl -- console-errors now excuses TWO platform-layer rules instead of one; the ADDED rule is NOT a project defect. (a) EVIDENCE it is the editor licence layer only: the single live error entry (unity command console --level error --tail 60 => returned=1, counts.error=1, groundTruth.consoleErrors=1; seq 6202 at 2026-09-22T09:44:37Z, logType=Exception) reads "UnityConnectWebRequestException: Token Exchange failed due a failure with the web request." and its ENTIRE stackTrace is UnityEditor.Connect.TokenExchange.VerifyTokenExchangeResponse / TokenExchangeRequestAsync / GetServiceTokenAsync / UnityEditor.Connect.ServiceToken.GetServiceTokenAsync / UnityEditor.Connect.UnityConnect.RequestNewServiceToken / AsyncMethodBuilderCore / UnityEngine.UnitySynchronizationContext -- i.e. ONLY UnityEditor.Connect.* and UnityEngine.*, with ZERO Diablo2.* and ZERO Clover* frames; tools/env-check.ps1 already records this host's unreachable endpoints, so this is the machine's restricted egress failing the EDITOR's own service-token exchange. (b) The whitelist stays NARROW -- the exact pattern text added inside tools/verify.ps1 section 17 is: $connect = ($eprov -like 'UnityEditor.Connect*') -or ($estack -like '*UnityEditor.Connect.TokenExchange*') ; $rule2 = $connect -and $emsg.Contains('UnityConnectWebRequestException') -and $emsg.Contains('Token Exchange failed') -- i.e. an editor-side provider-or-stack AND both exact message substrings are ALL required, so the same message text raised from a Diablo2 frame is NOT excused; the filtered/remaining machinery is untouched (remaining is still max(kept.Count, errorCount - filtered.Count), so a truncated entry list can never turn a red into a green) and every filtered entry is still printed verbatim. (c) Two-sample self-check per SKILL 8.3, both originals in .ai-tmp/test/console-whitelist-selftest.txt: known-good = the live session => PASS (filtered=1 remaining=0); injected defect = our own NullReferenceException at Diablo2.Module.Player.PlayerController.Tick fed to the SAME sliced filter code alongside the platform entry => FAIL (filtered=1 remaining=1) with the kept=1 line naming it; 8/8 cases OK. Evidence: .ai-tmp/test/console-status-before.json, .ai-tmp/test/console-error-entry.json, .ai-tmp/test/console-whitelist-selftest.txt, .ai-tmp/test/console_whitelist_selftest.ps1.
